mcqs.question: Under the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme in Andhra Pradesh, during which period was the annual fishing ban observed in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: The fishing ban under the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme was observed from 15 April to 14 June 2025, a period of approximately 61 days. The tempting alternative of 15 April to 14 July is incorrect because the ban ended on 14 June.
